attBesluta.text: I purchased this climber so my kids would have something to climb in the playroom. They absolutely love it. It's been a few months and they're still on it every day. I got a circular rug for under it and if they aren't climbing on the structure they are playing under it. I highly recommend this climber
Easy to put together if you have a son who can do it for you sturdy
super bien todo, llego super rápido y esta precioso tal cual a la foto, resaltar que hay que leer muy detenidamente las instrucciones para tener un montaje rápido y seguro.

Great product at a great price. Delivery was pretty quick and the instructions are clear. Took about 1.5 hours to put together myself and the final product feels very sturdy. I was worried this would be too small for my kiddos, but my 2 and 3 year old love it. I’d say this size is good for kiddos up to 6 years old, then after that you should probably go with the bigger size. Highly recommend!
Bought for my 2yr old grandson who loves climbing and he loves it can't send a video due to advertising young children but he loves it highly recommended thanks
Velice dobrý produkt po sestavení. Ale samotná stavba je poměrně náročná a návod není úplně dobře pochopitelný. Některé části trochu neseděly. Práce minimálně pro dva muže.
This is worth purchasing if you want the kids to have hours of fun. Putting it together was like putting together a puzzle and I love puzzles. I would purchase again a

Très satisfait de mon achat, mes enfants (4 et 9 ans) sont ravis, le hamac permet de redescendre du haut de la structure ou juste de s'installer pour jouer ou regarder le ciel. La notice de montage est en anglais mais très bien détaillée avec des photos couleurs, effectivement il faut être deux et 2h, il est bien de regarder quelques pages d'avances pour s'aider, un cliquet est très pratique. Livraison prévue en 1 semaine, livrée au bout de 3 jrs. Je n'ai pas mis 5 étoiles pour la qualité car la grêle avait fait 3 petits impacts sur deux barres mais Le SAV exceptionnel et ultra rapide pour me proposer une solution, j'ai trouvé le service très professionnel. Encore merci VEVOR.
Great product! Very easy to assemble and sturdy. We especially liked the gripping handles, for easy climbing and safety. Great addition to any backyard playground.

Needs 2 people to put together and 1.5 hours. We had 4 children on it at once. In my opinion it is great for kids age 3-7, but would be a bit too small for 10 year olds to have fun on. The swing is only really usable for young ones. Our 6 yo was bashing his head or dragging legs… The hammock is really handy as a bit of a fall protection as well. The structure can be lifted up easily by 2 adults and moved around the garden to mow grass or seek a sunny spot. Build quality is OK, although some washers were missing. Cost is OK, but you could get a bit more fun out of Rebo monkey bars / swing combination for the same money, if you had to choose. We have both, so can compare value for money that way.
Tutto perfetto. Ottima cupola, i miei nipoti la adorano.
Such a great buy, wish I bought it earlier:0) kids love it - works for all ages, super sturdy and well put together

La cupola sembra molto stabile... Una delle protezioni in plastica è arrivata rotta.. cercherò di sostituirla. Montaggio non semplice, tuttavia sono riuscita a montarla tutta da sola, con qualche imprecazione ma ce l'ho fatta! In due sicuramente è più semplice e più veloce, la parte più difficile è tenere le varie barre con una mano mentre con l'altra cerchi di chiudere col bullone la vite che le tiene insieme. Attenzione alle istruzioni, sono comprensibili ma essendo in inglese bisogna fare attenzione. In ogni caso i passaggi sono scritti tutti giusti.
Confusing to put together! It’s all about the angles!!
È un pacco pesante, ma una volta assemblato, avrete una struttura da arrampicata molto bella e robusta per i vostri bambini. Il nostro bambino di 4 anni ne è felicissimo.

My kids love this. This one is really big for the money in my opinion. It might not be built as heavy as some, but I expect my kids to lose interest in it by the time they are too big for it. I'm very pleased with it.
Great size and very sturdy.. kids love it and multiple people can play together.

Great replacement for other yard toys. You will need AT LEAST TWO (2) adults to assemble this. Don't think you can do it all by yourself, because unless you have five hands, it will be next to impossible. Three assemblers is handy when you start the second level. The kids love it and that is all that matters.
